implemented_requirements.requirement: Player presses a key to 'flap' and keep the bird from falling
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.handle_events() maps KEYDOWN (SPACE or UP) to Game.action(), which calls Bird.flap() (bird.py). Bird.flap() sets velocity to settings.FLAP_VELOCITY, and Bird.update() applies gravity each frame.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Randomly generated vertical gaps in 'pipes' appear
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.spawn_pipe() calls Pipe.random_gap_center(gap_size) to pick a vertical center; Pipe.__init__ stores gap_center and gap_size. Pipe.draw() renders the two pipe sections with that gap.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each successful pass increases the score
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update_score() iterates over self.pipes, uses Pipe.has_passed(self.bird.x) to detect passing, calls pipe.mark_scored() and increments self.score by settings.SCORE_PER_PIPE.

implemented_requirements.requirement: The game ends if the bird collides with a pipe or the ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.check_collisions() checks bird_rect.bottom against ground_top and calls self.game_over() on collision; it also iterates over pipes and uses Pipe.collides_with(bird_rect) to detect pipe collisions.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Gradually adjust difficulty by varying gap sizes and pipe speeds
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.current_gap_size() reduces the gap based on score (settings.GAP_DECREASE_PER_POINT) with random variation; Game.current_pipe_speed() increases speed based on score (settings.SPEED_INCREASE_PER_POINT). Both are used in pipe spawning and movement.

judge.summary: All core features of the Flappy Bird clone are present in the provided source files. The bird can be flapped via keyboard/mouse, gravity is applied, pipes with random vertical gaps are generated, scoring on passing pipes works, collisions end the game, and difficulty scales with score. The code appears syntactically correct and likely runnable with pygame, giving a high confidence of successful execution.
